# BLOK

> BLOK (بلوك) is an Egyptian streetwear brand selling winter jackets and hoodies with a European style, ordered through WhatsApp. Site language: Egyptian Arabic.

## Key facts
- Brand: BLOK, also written Blok Fashion. Current collection: DROP 01, WINTER 26.
- Market: Egypt. Currency: EGP (Egyptian pounds).
- How to order: look up a product by its code (BLK-xxx) on the site, then order on WhatsApp +201023279424.
- Prices on the site are suggested site prices, shipping is not included. Price and availability are confirmed on WhatsApp before the order.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BlockFashion2027
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blokfashion2027/

## Pages
- [BLOK home: price lookup, catalog, order form](https://g77577076-hue.github.io/blok-site/): Arabic (ar-EG) single page site.
